# Deer

Internal ID: Deer | Type: Passive | Faction: Forest | Main biome: Meadows, Black Forest | Tameable: No | Drops: Deer hide, Deer trophy, Deer meat | Trophy: Deer trophy | Neutral to (x1): Blunt, ,, Slash, ,, Pierce, ,, Fire, ,, Frost, ,, Lightning, ,, Poison | Immune to (x0): Spirit, ,, Chop, ,, Pickaxe

# Introduction

Deer are passive creatures found in Meadows and Black Forests. They are four-legged, reddish-brown animals that are extremely timid and completely harmless.

## Drops

• Item: Deer hide | 0 Star: 1–2 | 1 Star: 2–4 | 2 Star: 4–8

• Item: Deer trophy | 0 Star: 50% | 1 Star: 50% | 2 Star: 50%

• Item: Deer meat | 0 Star: 2 | 1 Star: 4 | 2 Star: 8

## Spawning

• Type: Anywhere in forests of Meadows | Limit: 4 | Frequency: Common | Stars: Yes

• Type: Anywhere in Black Forest | Limit: 4 | Frequency: Common | Stars: Yes

## Notes

• The most distinguishable way to tell the level of a deer from a distance is by looking at its antlers or lack there of. Antlers or large antlers indicate the deer is starred.
• In an Alpha build of Valheim, the equivalent of a 2-starred deer had antlers and a greenish-blue glow.

Categorias: Passive creatures
